title: Users surface lists principals when principalDirectory is applied, and renders access-denied for non-admin
iWant: a users route that lists every principal identified by data-user-id with invite, deactivate, last-active and status columns when the applied auth blueprint declares principalDirectory; and an access-denied state with a request-access control for a principal without admin scope
soThat: I can see and act on the identity set the applied auth blueprint provides, and non-admin users have a clear next step when they hit the console

acceptanceCriteria.desc: Given an authenticated admin AND an applied auth blueprint declaring principalDirectory, the users table lists every principal with data-user-id on each row, a role column (only when roleModel is applied; else suppressed), a last-active timestamp, and a status column; a principal without admin scope reaching /admin renders an access-denied state with a "request access" control routing to POST /api/request-access. Probed by application-admin-console pack check AC-21102-1.

Each row exposes an invite control for a principal without an active session (data-action="invite") and a deactivate control for an active principal (data-action="deactivate"); the controls are keyboard-reachable buttons.
